decision_rationale: This is a new generative framework, TissueCraftAI, not a review or wrapper. It is centered on histology-to-spatial-omics generation with natural language prompts as the conditioning bridge.
evidence_snippet: "generative artificial intelligence framework that predicts multi-modal spatial omics maps directly from standard histology images using natural language prompts"; "text-guided latent diffusion model"; "structured text prompts"; "predict [protein/gene name] protein/RNA expression"; "histology images" / "spatial proteomics and transcriptomics"
